raw_corpus_note: The full corpus (~231 MB, dominated by the spans column) is NOT mirrored into this repository. Reproducibility is via this script plus the pinned revision above; raw/manifest.json lists every source session consumed.
transformation_steps: 2. Project (benchmark, harness) from every shard to locate the target cell.
3. Read RUN_COLS + spans from only the shards containing the target cell.
4. Filter rows to the target benchmark/harness.
5. Task prompt = first user text part of the first span's input messages.
6. Outputs = per-span assistant text parts, in span order; tool_call parts excluded.
7. Group sessions by task_prompt_sha256; keep groups covering >= min_models models.

fields_not_mapped.spans[].attributes.gen_ai.tool.definitio: tool schemas, not needed for output-drift; very large (~400KB/span)
fields_not_mapped.spans[].attributes.gen_ai.system_instruc: not required for output centroid drift
fields_not_mapped.spans[].events: not required for output centroid drift
fields_not_mapped.agent_cost / benchmark_cost / max_tokens: cost fields, not part of the drift question
fields_not_mapped.tool_call / tool_call_response parts: present in the corpus but out of scope for drift; relevant to a future tool-claim study

known_corpus_caveats.row_count: 10056 rows measured, dataset card states ~10057 runs
known_corpus_caveats.rows_are_sessions: each row is one task session; 115 run_ids group them
known_corpus_caveats.single_agent: one model and one agent identity per session; no multi-agent structure
